machine: Device-C = documented higher-aspect-ratio radial transform of validated MAST-U (device2_build.py --r0_old 0.9 --r0_new 1.6; A 1.34->2.25). Escalation ladder if NO-GO: r0_new 1.6 -> 1.9 -> 2.2 (toward conventional A>=2.8).

protocol.solve: cold forward solves (constrain=None), serialized Device-C machine
protocol.grid: 65x65, expanded Rmax=2.8 for Device-C (plasma sits at larger R)
protocol.rationale_modes: 40 modes is the CHEAP probe; corr(kappa,log m_s) is a RELATIVE (rank) measure within the probe at a fixed mode count, so the documented 40->80 absolute bias cancels. The design comparison (C4), if GO, uses the converged 80 modes.

primary_metric: corr(kappa, log m_s) = Spearman rank correlation on >=150 (target >=250) converged DIVERTED Device-C samples spanning a range of kappa.
secondary_metric: per-lever |Spearman(standardized descriptor, log m_s)| for the secondary levers {sq_uo, sq_lo, gap_inner, gap_outer, li, betap, delta}.

DECISION_RULE.GO: |corr(kappa, log m_s)| < 0.75  OR  best secondary lever's |corr| >= 0.7 * |corr(kappa)|.
DECISION_RULE.NO_GO: otherwise (kappa still dominant, |corr| ~0.8+ with no rival lever).

branch_on_result.GO: proceed to C4: the UNCONSTRAINED design comparison on Device-C (learned-m_s gradient vs reduce-kappa heuristic vs gradient-free; kappa FREE; every step 80-mode solver-confirmed).
branch_on_result.NO_GO: escalate aspect ratio (bigger r0_new) 1-2 times and re-probe. If kappa stays dominant even at conventional A, STOP and report the honest scoping result: 'kappa-dominance is a general property of tokamak vertical stability, not a MAST-U artifact.' Do NOT run C4 on a kappa-dominated device.

honesty: A within-noise 'win' is NOT a win. NO-GO and TIE are real, publishable scoping findings and will be reported plainly, not spun.
